svg.title: Ghori raises his notched ear and moves to the safe platform marker.
svg.desc: The station dog reacts to a distant vibration before the signs change, then walks to his usual safe marker. Babul-da recognises the behaviour while Cecil compares it with the empty track.
svg.text: Page 15, panel 3 · Low silent shot level with Ghori's head and the rail
